name: Kimi AI (www.kimi.ai)
description: Kimi AI assistant web app — chat with streaming answers, in-chat internet search, file/image upload, long-context mode. .cn mirror: kimi.moonshot.cn (login host login.moonshot.cn); canonical is www.kimi.ai.
author: ui2api capability package
siteVersion: Connect RPC on notilo.kimi.com/apiv2 — 411 methods / 45 protobuf services decoded from 99 JS bundles (~12MB); chat = ChatService.Chat (server-stream), search = kimi.chat.v1.Tool.Search{force} + search.v2.SearchService, files = POST /apiv2-files/file/upload

transport.protocol: Connect (connect-es v2) over HTTP POST; protobuf frames on the stream; no WebSocket for chat
transport.protoContext: request/response are Connect-wrapped protobuf messages (e.g. kimi.gateway.chat.v1.ChatRequest → stream<ChatResponse>); exact frame/binary payload layout NOT yet captured

auth.refresh: AuthService.RefreshToken{refresh_token} → rewrites both keys; Code.Unauthenticated → cleanToken + logout

headers.x-msh-shield-data: optional TrustDecision(同盾) blackbox via window._fmOpt.getinfo() — page-injected, may be required once abuse signals appear

transport.streaming: server-streaming: ChatService.Chat returns a Connect HTTP stream of ChatResponse which the client slices into kimi.chat.v1.Block / TextBlock / message_ref segments; ResumeChat marks isStreaming=false and auto-resumes dropped chunks

capabilities.name: Chat
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer; streamed answer off the page (ChatService.Chat server-stream on notilo.kimi.com/apiv2)
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)
capabilities.implementation: ChatService.Chat (kimi.gateway.chat.v1) server-streaming POST /apiv2/kimi.gateway.chat.v1/ChatService/Chat; ChatRequest carries chat_id, kimiplus_id, scenario (enum CHAT=1/THINK=2/DEEP_RESEARCH=3/…), tools, message (kimi.chat.v1.ChatMessage), options{thinking, reasoning_effort, context_length, model(10)}. Payload field layout NOT yet verified on the wire — a later incarnation may call it directly via page fetch + protobuf; the DOM path below drives the SPA.

capabilities.name: Web search toggle (in-chat internet mode)
capabilities.description: Flip the composer web-search switch so the answer is grounded by live search (feeds kimi.chat.v1.Tool{type:TOOL_TYPE_SEARCH, search{force}} on ChatService.Chat). VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-19: triggered via the toolkit drawer — [data-testid='toolkit-trigger-btn'] opens it, then click button.toolkit-item 'Web Search'; pre-boot clicks dropped → openToolkitItem() polls/re-clicks the trigger up to 15s.
capabilities.implementation: openToolkitItem(page, 'Web Search'): click [data-testid='toolkit-trigger-btn'], wait for button.toolkit-item rows (re-click trigger when none render), click the matching row, close toolkit. In-chat search is a tool on the chat RPC (Tool{type:TOOL_TYPE_SEARCH, search{force}}); per-message citations via ChatService.GetSearchCitation + GetToolBlock.

capabilities.name: Conversation history list
capabilities.description: List past chats (ChatService.ListChats / ListMessages). VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-19: sidebar DOM read returns 15 real conversations via a.next-sidebar-history-item__link (fallback a[href^='/chat/']), href /chat/<uuid>?chat_enter_method=history — page.waitForSelector({timeout:15000}) replaces the fixed 3s wait (raced cold boot).
capabilities.method: ui-path (DOM sidebar read) — LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-19; wire ListChats RPC still needs protobuf framing
capabilities.implementation: openPage() → wait a.next-sidebar-history-item__link (15s) → page.evaluate extracting {id (uuid from href), title (innerText)} deduped, capped at 20. Wire equivalent ChatService.ListChats (kimi.gateway.chat.v1) documented in CAPABILITIES.md §4; payload layout to be verified on a future live capture.

capabilities.name: File / image upload support
capabilities.description: Attach documents or images to a chat — REST multipart POST /apiv2-files/file/upload (FileService.Upload) with parse tracking (GetFileParseProgress, ListChatFiles). VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-19 via the composer attach UI: label.toolkit-item 'Add files & images' wraps hidden input[type='file'].hidden-input; attach via setInputFiles on the input (Playwright filechooser event NEVER fires on this UI). Attachment chip confirmed: 'kimi-attach-test / TXT / 52 Bytes'.
capabilities.implementation: openToolkitItem('Add files & images') → page.locator('input[type=file]').setInputFiles(path) (NOT filechooser). Wire: POST https://notilo.kimi.com/apiv2-files/file/upload (multipart, responseType text) + lightweight POST /file/upload_simple; kimi.gateway.file.v1.FileService.Upload (client-streaming), GetFileParseProgress, ChatService.ListChatFiles; image blob host https://kimi-img.moonshot.cn.
capabilities.notes: Upload flow VERIFIED live 2026-09-19 (attach UI path); wire-first /apiv2-files/file/upload recipe retained for future direct-RPC use

capabilities.name: Long-context / long-context-only mode
capabilities.description: Set context_length / context-length-only mode on ChatRequestOptions (kimi.common.v1.ContextLength) for long-input answers
capabilities.implementation: MEASURED LIVE 2026-09-23: picker = button[data-testid='model-context-length-item'] (only renders for models carrying contextLengthOptions — K3 family, not Instant); options = button[data-testid='model-context-length-option'] with data-context-length=<ContextLength enum> (decoded: 5=L 'Standard' default, 6=XL 'Extra Long'). Applying Standard → ok:true; Extra Long is PLAN-GATED on free accounts (measured upgrade modal data-testid='confirm-dialog': 'Available to subscribers on the Max plan or higher') → honest blocker. Feeds ChatRequestOptions.context_length on the next ChatService.Chat send.
capabilities.notes: Picker + enum codes live-verified 2026-09-23 (runner proof); Extra Long plan-gated on this account; needs a Max-plan session to apply XL

capabilities.name: Model picker read
capabilities.description: Read the available models from the model picker DOM (selectModelEntry state key + GetAvailableModels RPC proven in bundles). VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-19: click [data-testid='model-select-trigger'] → read button.model-item rows (name = first innerText line), selected flagged via .checked class; Escape closes. Live read returned: K3, K3 Swarm, K2.8, Instant (selected).
capabilities.implementation: page.locator('[data-testid="model-select-trigger"]').click() → wait button.model-item → evaluate rows {id:null, name: first line, selected: contains '.checked'} → Escape to close. Returns {model, selected} per row.

auth.note: Auth is localStorage access_token (replayed as Bearer on notilo.kimi.com/apiv2, plus site-internal x-msh-shield-data TrustDecision header). Refresh via AuthService.RefreshToken; on Unauthenticated cleanToken() logs out. Verified live 2026-09-18: session with access_token/refresh_token/msh_user_id drives the ChatService.Chat UI round-trip.

permissions: requires a real logged-in Kimi session snapshot (access_token in localStorage)
anti-bot: TrustDecision(同盾) blackbox + VolcanoEngine analytics on the page — no synthetic inputs, use the site's own JS paths
quota/captcha gates may fire on abuse signals (QUOTA_EXCEEDED_WINDOW_5H/7D, REASON_ACCOUNT_CAPTCHA_VERIFY_FAILED)
analysisMethod: static JS-bundle analysis (see CAPABILITIES.md — 99 bundles / ~12MB, 411 RPC methods / 45 services); session captured + chat round-trip live-verified 2026-09-18 (answer selector grounded: .toolcall-rollup__part:has(+ .toolcall-rollup__tail) > .markdown-container > .markdown excludes the thinking block). LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-19: list_conversations, model_list, web_search, file_upload UI paths (runner runs, proofs PASS 14098) against locked session 2026-09-18T14:42:47Z.
